method: GitHub API: repo created 2026-07-29, 835 stars / 90 forks / 29 open issues as of 2026-08-03; read the open issue list for design constraints.
gap: It is wired to Copilot CLI, Microsoft Scout and Copilot Studio, ships as an Electron source install, and is aimed at enterprise workflow authors. The ordinary-person version — 'show it once, it does it for you from then on' with nothing to configure — does not exist, and nothing exists for the Chinese desktop at all.

zh.gap: 它绑死在 Copilot CLI / Microsoft Scout / Copilot Studio 上，以 Electron 源码方式安装，面向的是企业流程作者。普通人那个版本——「做一遍给它看，以后它替你做」，不用配置任何东西——不存在，中文桌面这边更是完全空白。
zh.pain: 每个月都要把同一套繁琐操作点一遍的人——写不出脚本，也说不清楚到让 AI 接手。
zh.kill: 微软亲自占着这个位置，分发能力摆在那；而且演示本身是一份有损的说明书，维护者自己的 issue 里就写了：录漏一步，生成的技能就是坏的。fork 只有星数的 11%，目前还是开发者好奇，不算被验证的需求。
zh.move: 这里只当能力信号，不当生意：机会在普通人那一侧——挑一件家里每月重复的窄活，用示范教会它，全程本地跑，屏幕录像一帧都不出这台机器。冷启动（中文）：小红书、B 站「办公自动化」「重复劳动」教程下的评论区，那里的人会把自己最烦的那套月度流程一条条说出来。冷启动（英文）：r/Automate 与 r/productivity 搜 automate this thing I do every month。

pain: The person who clicks through the same tedious ritual every single month and can neither script it nor describe it precisely enough for an AI to take over.
kill: Microsoft is occupying this directly and has the distribution; a demonstration is also a lossy spec, and the maintainers' own issue tracker notes recordings that miss a step produce a broken skill. Forks are 11% of stars, so this is still developer curiosity rather than proven demand.
move: Treated here as a capability signal, not a business: the opportunity is the consumer wedge — one narrow recurring household chore taught by demonstration, running locally, with the screen recording never leaving the machine. Cold start (Chinese): Xiaohongshu and Bilibili comment sections under 办公自动化 / 重复劳动 tutorials, where people describe the exact monthly ritual they hate. Cold start (English): r/Automate and r/productivity, search 'automate this thing I do every month'.
